datasets.name: total_transactions
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_transactions
FROM
  finguard.silver.transactions

datasets.name: total_volume
queryLines:
SELECT
  CONCAT('₹', FORMAT_NUMBER(SUM(amount), '#,##0')) AS total_volume
FROM
  finguard.silver.transactions

datasets.name: avg_amount
queryLines:
SELECT
  CONCAT('₹', FORMAT_NUMBER(AVG(amount), '#,##0.00')) AS avg_amount
FROM
  finguard.silver.transactions

datasets.name: active_customers
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS active_customers
FROM
  finguard.silver.transactions

datasets.name: high_value_alerts
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS high_value_alerts
FROM
  finguard.gold.high_value_transactions_alert

datasets.name: fraud_card_alerts
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS fraud_card_alerts
FROM
  finguard.gold.fraud_card_alert

datasets.name: watchlist_entries
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS watchlist_entries
FROM
  finguard.silver.fraud_watchlist

datasets.name: intl_transactions
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS intl_transactions
FROM
  finguard.silver.transactions
WHERE
  is_international = true

datasets.name: txn_volume_by_category
queryLines:
SELECT
  merchant_category,
  COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
  ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM
  finguard.silver.transactions
GROUP BY
  merchant_category
ORDER BY
  total_amount DESC

datasets.name: txn_by_channel
queryLines:
SELECT
  payment_channel,
  COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM
  finguard.silver.transactions
GROUP BY
  payment_channel
ORDER BY
  transaction_count DESC

datasets.name: top_cities
queryLines:
SELECT
  city,
  COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
  ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM
  finguard.silver.transactions
GROUP BY
  city
ORDER BY
  total_amount DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: intl_vs_dom
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN is_international THEN 'International'
    ELSE 'Domestic'
  END AS txn_type,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM
  finguard.silver.transactions
GROUP BY
  is_international

datasets.name: txn_type_dist
queryLines:
SELECT
  transaction_type,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM
  finguard.silver.transactions
GROUP BY
  transaction_type
ORDER BY
  count DESC

datasets.name: currency_dist
queryLines:
SELECT
  currency,
  COUNT(*) AS count,
  ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM
  finguard.silver.transactions
GROUP BY
  currency
ORDER BY
  total_amount DESC

datasets.name: customer_segment_dist
queryLines:
SELECT
  customer_segment,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM
  finguard.silver.customers
GROUP BY
  customer_segment
ORDER BY
  customer_count DESC

datasets.name: risk_score_dist
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN risk_score BETWEEN 0 AND 10 THEN 'Low (0-10)'
    WHEN risk_score BETWEEN 11 AND 30 THEN 'Medium (11-30)'
    WHEN risk_score BETWEEN 31 AND 50 THEN 'High (31-50)'
    WHEN risk_score > 50 THEN 'Very High (>50)'
  END AS risk_band,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM
  finguard.silver.customers
GROUP BY
  risk_band
ORDER BY
  risk_band

datasets.name: card_type_dist
queryLines:
SELECT
  card_type,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM
  finguard.silver.customers
GROUP BY
  card_type
ORDER BY
  count DESC

datasets.name: avg_income_segment
queryLines:
SELECT
  customer_segment,
  ROUND(AVG(annual_income), 2) AS avg_income,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM
  finguard.silver.customers
GROUP BY
  customer_segment
ORDER BY
  avg_income DESC

datasets.name: gender_dist
queryLines:
SELECT
  gender,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM
  finguard.silver.customers
GROUP BY
  gender

datasets.name: watchlist_details
queryLines:
SELECT
  watchlist_id,
  watch_type,
  entity_id,
  risk_level,
  action,
  reason_code,
  reason_description,
  status,
  reported_by,
  country,
  city
FROM
  finguard.silver.fraud_watchlist
ORDER BY
  risk_level DESC

datasets.name: total_windowed_1min
queryLines:
SELECT
  SUM(transaction_count) AS total_windowed_txn_count
FROM
  finguard.gold.transaction_count_by_minute

datasets.name: watchlist_reason
queryLines:
SELECT
  reason_code,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM
  finguard.silver.fraud_watchlist
GROUP BY
  reason_code
ORDER BY
  count DESC

datasets.name: peak_txn_minutes
queryLines:
SELECT
  window_start,
  SUM(transaction_count) AS total_txn_count
FROM
  finguard.gold.transaction_count_by_minute
GROUP BY
  window_start
ORDER BY
  total_txn_count DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: txn_velocity_5min
queryLines:
SELECT
  window_start,
  SUM(transaction_count) AS total_txn_count
FROM
  finguard.gold.transaction_count_by_minute_sliding_window
GROUP BY
  window_start
ORDER BY
  window_start

datasets.name: txn_count_1min
queryLines:
SELECT
  window_start,
  SUM(transaction_count) AS total_txn_count
FROM
  finguard.gold.transaction_count_by_minute
GROUP BY
  window_start
ORDER BY
  window_start

datasets.name: watchlist_risk_level
queryLines:
SELECT
  risk_level,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM
  finguard.silver.fraud_watchlist
GROUP BY
  risk_level
ORDER BY
  count DESC

datasets.name: fc_alerts_table
queryLines:
SELECT
  alert_id,
  alert_type,
  alert_timestamp,
  transaction_id,
  customer_id,
  customer_name,
  customer_email,
  card_number,
  amount,
  currency,
  merchant_name,
  merchant_category,
  transaction_type,
  payment_channel,
  transaction_city,
  transaction_country,
  transaction_status,
  watch_type,
  risk_level,
  action,
  reason_code,
  reason_description
FROM
  finguard.gold.fraud_card_alert
ORDER BY
  alert_timestamp DESC

datasets.name: top_states
queryLines:
SELECT
  state,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM
  finguard.silver.customers
GROUP BY
  state
ORDER BY
  customer_count DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: hv_alerts_table
queryLines:
SELECT
  alert_id,
  alert_type,
  alert_timestamp,
  transaction_id,
  customer_id,
  customer_name,
  email,
  amount,
  transaction_type,
  transaction_status,
  transaction_channel,
  transaction_country,
  transaction_city
FROM
  finguard.gold.high_value_transactions_alert
ORDER BY
  alert_timestamp DESC

datasets.name: total_windowed_sliding
queryLines:
SELECT
  SUM(transaction_count) AS total_sliding_txn_count
FROM
  finguard.gold.transaction_count_by_minute_sliding_window
